title: Cycle-free shared proof API for finite coefficient descent
statement: Let X be a topologically Noetherian scheme and ℓ a prime. For each finite coefficient field E in the specified algebraic closure of Q_ℓ, the object property boundedConstructible (padicSubfieldRingObj X ℓ E) is triangulated. The module also extracts the existing private cocone-factorization and exact-left-derived-composition-shift helpers, allowing their original consumers and the support-induction proof to share one proof without an import cycle.

source.place: private finiteBoundedTriangulated, bounded_tri_of_serre, single_bounded_constructible and HomFactorization helpers; exact left-derived shift compatibility extracted from lean/Sheaf/Paper/CondensedFlatCoefficientCalculus.lean

proof.text: Apply the finite-coefficient constructible Serre theorem, package its kernel, cokernel and extension closure clauses as object-property instances, and use isTriangulated_boundedConstructible. The other extracted private helpers are the existing categorical transport proofs; none uses finite-presentation object descent or the support-induction item.

proof_origin.place: Extraction of existing proved private helpers for reuse without a cycle
